shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side. A woman in a cobalt blazer sits in the screen-side window seat, telling about a scheduling mishap. A man in an olive sweater sits in the door-side window seat. A woman in a maroon blouse sits in the screen-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the glass-door end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in an olive sweater asks the woman in a cobalt blazer how the issue was resolved.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the walkway side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a cobalt blazer answers the man in an olive sweater that the meeting was rescheduled.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the presentation-screen end, looking lengthwise along the conference table toward the glass door, with both window-side seats and the screen-end seat in frame.
